summaryZh: 语言与婴儿学习实验室研究语言和认知如何发展，关注儿童如何学习新词与概念，以及驱动学习的因素。具体方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 婴儿、儿童和成人如何发展语言能力并成为熟练的语言使用者？
儿童如何学习新词和概念，哪些因素驱动并激励这些学习？

evidence.quote: LIL Lab Welcome to the Language and Infant Learning Lab! In the LIL (Language and Infant Learning) Lab , we study how language and cognition develops. We are part of the Department of Cognitive Science at the University of California, San Diego . In our research, we study how infants, children, and adults develop and become skilled language users. We ask questions about how children learn new words and concepts, as well as investigate the driving factors that motivate learning. Learn more on our research page or read up on our recent publications . If you're interested in participating in our current studies, check out this page !
